'''2011 US Nationals Kevin Shannon LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Deck name:''' Dark Deck Super Awesome Southern California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
